tasha: hi all starting today — quick clarification: where do i post laptop/wifi/VPN hardware issues vs process/"who-to-ask" questions vs general intro? also how do i quiet onboarding reminders (they're helpful but a bit noisy).

sam: welcome! :wave: Device or hardware issues -> DM @it-support or post in #help if you want teammates to see. Process/who-owns -> #new-hires or the specific team channel (e.g., #eng, #product). Intros -> #introductions (1-line timezone + role + repos).

it-support: tracked requests: use `/ticket create "VPN/laptop issue" --attach diagnostics` or DM us with `vpn diag` output. Typical ETA 1-4 hours. For privilege/access requests follow instructions in #dev-access and include the resource list.

devops: note on access: if you need cloud/project access follow the access repo flow (link in #dev-access). Quick route: open a PR in access repo with the list and tag @devops for review.

eng-oncall-bot: New hire checklist: run `onboard status` in the CLI. To reduce reminders DM @onboarding-bot `preferences minimal` or `unsubscribe` to stop non-critical pings. You can also `@onboarding-bot remind me in 48h` for a specific follow-up.

lee: etiquette: keep long troubleshooting in a thread so channels don't get noisy; never paste tokens or screenshots with secrets in public channels 1 use a ticket or a secure doc. If uncertain where to post, start in #new-hires with a short subject line and ask where to route it.

tasha: perfect, thanks everyone! i'll DM it-support the VPN logs and post a short intro in #introductions (PST, infra eng). will mute non-essential bot pings for now. :thumbsup:
